HPACK Header Compression for HTTP/2

Implements RFC 7541 - HPACK: Header Compression for HTTP/2. Provides encoding and decoding of HTTP/2 header fields.

Types

DynamicTable = object
HpackDecoder = object
HpackEncoder = object
